title: What Does It Mean 'To Mushroom'? (2/2)
summaryZh: 介紹 mushroom 當動詞的用法，用來形容事情快速膨脹、甚至擴大到失控。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Words and Their Stories

sentences.text: We can even say something has mushroomed out of control.
sentences.zh: 我們甚至可以說某件事已經暴增到失控的地步。

sentences.text: For example, paying your bills on time and keeping track of your spending will prevent money problems from mushrooming out of control.
sentences.zh: 例如，準時繳帳單、掌握自己的開銷，就能避免金錢問題暴增到失控。

sentences.text: We can also use mushroom as a phrasal verb.
sentences.zh: mushroom 也可以當片語動詞使用。

sentences.text: If something mushrooms into something else, it changes very quickly.
sentences.zh: 如果某件事 mushroom 成了另一件事，就表示它變化得非常快。

sentences.text: For example, I had planned a simple picnic lunch with two friends.
sentences.zh: 例如，我本來只打算和兩個朋友吃個簡單的野餐午餐。

sentences.text: But after they invited more people, it mushroomed into a much bigger party, with lots of great food.
sentences.zh: 但他們又找了更多人來，結果就變成一場大很多的派對，還有一堆好料。

sentences.text: What began as small edits to my story mushroomed into a complete rewrite.
sentences.zh: 本來只是想小改一下我的文章，最後卻變成整篇重寫。

sentences.text: And that's the end of Words and Their Stories.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本集的 Words and Their Stories。

sentences.text: Until next time, I'm Ana Mateo.
